mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the preceding 6 months raises the cost of capital, reducing present value of future corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp per quarter for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the median return is not statistically different from zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls YoY for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the average return is not significantly below zero at 5% significance.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6.0% and remains there for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the hit rate is below 40%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals supply-side stress, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-mo moving average for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes or median return is not significantly negative at 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a monetary policy tightening coinciding with rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed 12-mo moving average in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns are not significantly negative in triggered months or the event hit rate is below 40%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong concurrent rise in both personal income (PAYEMS) and real retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both exceed 12-mo moving average in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are not significantly positive in triggered months or the event hit rate is below 50%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in the unemployment rate below 4% for four consecutive months signals an overheating labor market, which typically precedes monetary tightening and higher input costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60d returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods or the hit rate is below 40%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which drags on construction-related sectors and overall corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 12-mo moving average for six consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20d returns are not significantly negative in triggered episodes or the event hit rate is below 50%.
